items.t: Said Gov. Beshear's demand that every ICE agent be removed from every city makes Kentucky and America less safe.
items.q: Kentucky Attorney General Russell Coleman responded to Gov. Andy Beshear's demand on 'The View' that 'every' ICE agent be removed from every city — saying his position makes Kentucky and America less safe.

items.t: Launched a $15 million grant program through the Attorney General's office to equip local law enforcement agencies with body armor and other gear (2024).
items.q: Attorney General Russell Coleman launched a $15 million grant program to equip local law enforcement agencies with much-needed body armor and other gear.

items.t: Announced a lawsuit against Roblox over child predators on its platform (2025).
items.q: Attorney General Russell Coleman announced today a major lawsuit against Roblox—a popular gaming and social media platform with more than 380 million monthly users—for creating a hunting ground for child predators.

items.t: Said TikTok was designed to be an addiction machine targeting children.
items.q: TikTok was specifically designed to be an addiction machine, targeting children who are still in the process of developing appropriate self-control.

items.t: Alleges that platforms like Instagram and Facebook deliberately designed addictive features to hook young users.
items.q: Coleman alleges that platforms like Instagram and Facebook deliberately designed addictive features to hook young users, leading to a youth mental health crisis.

items.t: Said Kalshi and Polymarket are operating illegal sportsbooks in Kentucky.
items.q: Kalshi and Polymarket are operating illegal sportsbooks in Kentucky and breaking our laws

record.t: Announced he and Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall are leading a 13-state coalition concerning public university professors and academic freedom.
record.q: Attorney General Russell Coleman announced today he and Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall are leading a 13-state coalition to stop public university professors from hiding behind ‘academic freedom’

record.t: Announced three lawsuits against prediction market platforms, a sweepstakes gambling platform and a cryptocurrency platform.
record.q: Attorney General Russell Coleman announced today, in defense of Kentucky law, the launch of three lawsuits against prediction market platforms, a sweepstakes gambling platform and a cryptocurrency platform.

record.t: Filed a lawsuit against TikTok and its affiliated entities.
record.q: Attorney General Russell Coleman announced today the filing of a lawsuit against TikTok and its affiliated entities for the social media platform’s exploitation of Kentucky’s young people to turn a profit.

record.office: United States Attorney for the Western District of Kentucky
record.t: Was nominated by President Trump and unanimously confirmed by the Senate as United States Attorney for the Western District of Kentucky.
record.q: In 2017, he was nominated by President Trump and unanimously confirmed by the Senate to be the United States Attorney for the Western District of Kentucky.

record.t: Joined a letter signed by a bipartisan majority of state attorneys general regarding states' ability to regulate sports betting on prediction market platforms like Kalshi.
